Both use a grid capped at 32*SMs with row grid-strides, full per-row CSR traversal, reductions and stores. A graph is captured with batch=min(iterations,64) launches when batch>1. The separate synchronized warmup runs the graph when available, otherwise one kernel. Timed work is exactly iterations/batch graph launches plus iterations%batch direct calls, or iterations direct calls without a graph. Complete compiled spmvGpu retains selection, capture, quotient and remainder backedges, selected-pointer cudaLaunchKernel calls and stop-event synchronization. All six selectable native sm86 bodies retain full arithmetic loops and stores; primary independently checked the full long-row body. No omission identified.
